payload.title: Plexus is a classifier lab: operationalizing classifiers at scale
payload.description: The offer article. Start with a business problem, not a model, then walk one classifier through the Plexus loop: labelled examples, evaluation, confidence gating, human review, retraining, controlled rollout, and what the scorecard looks like at month one versus month six. Reuse the checkable figures already published in the distillation piece (ANTH-123b30) and the Classification with Confidence work rather than inventing new ones; cite Call Criteria for the at-scale claim. End state: the reader knows the whole method and knows Anthus will run it for them. This is the top of the client-acquisition funnel; the Kanbus and Papyrus pieces sit under it and all three land on the same engagement page (site board).
